ValidationRule.description: A trig haversine cross-check (SIN/COS/ATAN2/SQRT/PI) of the stored distance must agree with DISTANCE within 5% for international shipments.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Is_International__c, NOT(ISBLANK(Origin__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Destination__latitude__s)), ABS( 3958.8 * 2 * ATAN2( SQRT(SIN((Destination__latitude__s - Origin__latitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2 + COS(Origin__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * COS(Destination__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * SIN((Destination__longitude__s - Origin__longitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2), SQRT(1 - (SIN((Destination__latitude__s - Origin__latitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2 + COS(Origin__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * COS(Destination__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * SIN((Destination__longitude__s - Origin__longitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2)) ) - DISTANCE(Origin__c, Destination__c, 'mi') ) > 0.05 * MAX(1, DISTANCE(Origin__c, Destination__c, 'mi')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Origin/destination coordinates are inconsistent (haversine vs DISTANCE).
